summary: Iteration 147: Full System Validation of AI KARAU platform completed. Backend: 35/35 tests passed (100%). All requested features tested: Auth (login, register, 401), Webinar CRUD, roles, QA, hand raises, slides, live transcript, caption translation (16 languages, EN->ES/FR/JA), STT service, Recordings + AI Notes, Payments/Membership, Analytics. integration_issues.issue: 401 errors on API calls after navigating between pages in automated testing. Session cookie may not be set properly in headless browser - manual testing recommended to verify.
